versions.subject: Merge PR #4615 from @jstnk9 - Update WMIC Discovery Rule + New System Discovery Rules For MacOS
versions.detection:
# VT Query: 'behavior_processes:"sw_vers" and (behavior_processes:"-productVersion" or behavior_processes:"-productName" or behavior_processes:"-buildVersion") tag:dmg p:5+'
selection_image:
    Image|endswith: '/sw_vers'
selection_options:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-buildVersion'
        - '-productName'
        - '-productVersion'
condition: all of selection_*
